source_title: UPESSC Principal Recruitment 2026 Notification Out: Apply Online For 1475 Vacancies; Check Eligibility & Other Details - Jagran Josh
source_excerpt:
UP Principal Recruitment 2026 Notification OUT: UPESSC has released Advertisement No. 08/2026 for 1,475 Principal posts in aided secondary schools of Uttar Pradesh. Online applications run from October 23 to November 22, 2026, on the official website, upessc.up.gov.in.
UPESSC released notification for 1,475 Principal posts on Oct 23, 2026.
Online applications for Principal posts are open from Oct 23 to Nov 22, 2026.
The written exam for Principal recruitment is scheduled for Jan 7, 2027.
UPESSC Principal Recruitment 2026: UPESSC UP Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the official notification for the recruitment of Principals in aided non-government secondary schools of Uttar Pradesh on October 23, 2026. Advertisement No. 08/2026 invites online applications for a total of 1,475 posts , including 1,318 vacancies in boys' schools and 157 in girls' schools. The online registration and application process started on October 23, 2026, and candidates can apply till November 22, 2026. The written exam is scheduled for January 7, 2027. This recruitment offers an attractive salary in the range of Rs 78,000 to Rs 2,09,200. In this article, we have shared all the important details, including dates, vacancies, and the application process.
The UP Education Service Selection Commission has released the Principal (Pradhanacharya) recruitment notification for aided non-government secondary schools. Check the key details of the recruitment in the table given below.

The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the notification for UP Principal Recruitment 2026 on October 23, 2026. Under Advertisement No. 08/2026, it will fill 1,475 Pradhanacharya posts in aided non-government secondary schools: 1,318 in boys' schools and 157 in girls' schools. Candidates can apply online only, and the application fee can be paid till November 22, 2026. Corrections can be made till November 25, 2026, and the exam is on January 7, 2027.
